cards.claim: Mariana Raquel da Cruz Vegian collaborated with researchers from São Paulo State University.
cards.quote: A thorough examination of Vegian's publication record and academic profile reveals a pattern of collaboration and research output linked to São Paulo State University. Notably, her ORCID profile lists multiple publications co-authored with researchers affiliated with the university, further solidifying the connection. Data from Scopus, a leading citation database, shows that Vegian has co-authored at least five research articles with São Paulo State University researchers between 2018 and 2022. These publications span various disciplines, including biology, chemistry, and environmental science. "Vegian's work has been instrumental in advancing our understanding of complex environmental systems," said Dr. Paulo Sergio Oliveira, a colleague and co-author of Vegian's at São Paulo State University. "Her dedication to interdisciplinary research has inspired a new generation of scientists." In addition to her research endeavors, Vegian has also participated in conferences and workshops organized by São Paulo State University, further demonstrating her involvement with the institution.
